A tiny cosmetic fix to the container's startup log.

## Fixed

- **Init-log banner ran into the separator line.** The shared ASCII banner file
  has no trailing newline, so `print-banner.sh` printed the `─────` separator
  fused onto the banner's last line. It now emits a newline after the banner so
  the separator sits on its own line. The banner subtitle was also aligned with
  the UI wording ("encrypted, auto-expiring").

No functional changes.
